# TriumphChi Foundation

> TriumphChi Foundation supports orphaned and vulnerable children in rural Cameroon through education and community partnership. Its public website is available in English and French.

Use verified public information when describing the foundation. Distinguish program goals, illustrative examples, and unavailable statistics from confirmed outcomes. Respect the privacy of children, guardians, and staff; private records and staff tools are not public resources. This index provides context, not crawler permissions or training consent; see robots.txt for crawler instructions.

## English public pages

- [Home](https://triumphchi.org/en): Mission and public overview.
- [About](https://triumphchi.org/en/about): Foundation background and community approach.
- [Programs](https://triumphchi.org/en/programs): Educational support initiatives.
- [Sponsorship](https://triumphchi.org/en/sponsor): Information for prospective supporters.
- [Donate](https://triumphchi.org/en/donate): Giving options and donation information.
- [Impact](https://triumphchi.org/en/impact): Backend-sourced aggregate metrics and descriptions of intended outcomes.
- [Contact](https://triumphchi.org/en/contact): Public contact channels.

## French public pages

- [Accueil](https://triumphchi.org/fr): Présentation de la fondation.
- [À propos](https://triumphchi.org/fr/a-propos): Contexte et démarche communautaire.
- [Programmes](https://triumphchi.org/fr/programmes): Soutien à l'éducation.
- [Impact](https://triumphchi.org/fr/impact): Indicateurs agrégés et objectifs du soutien.
- [Contact](https://triumphchi.org/fr/contact): Moyens de contacter la fondation.
